## revdepcheck results

We checked 199 reverse dependencies (191 from CRAN + 8 from Bioconductor), comparing R CMD check results across CRAN and dev versions of this package.

 * We saw 6 new problems
 * We failed to check 5 packages

All 6 new problems result from intended changes in this release. We
notified the maintainers of all six packages by email on 13 November 2026.

* `autoReg` reads the confidence interval columns from
  `summary(pool(fit), conf.int = TRUE)` by their old `confint()`-style
  names (`` `2.5 %` ``/`` `97.5 %` ``), which mice 3.19.10 renamed to
  `conf.low`/`conf.high` (broom convention).
* `basecamb`, `parameters`, `RSquaredMI` and `RNAseqCovarImpute`
  (Bioconductor) have tests that compare against exact numbers from a
  seeded `mice()` run with the default method `pmm`. mice 3.19.12 fixes a
  bug in the matching of tied predicted values (#757), so the imputations
  for a given seed change. The packages themselves are not at fault; the
  expected values need updating.
* `mfrmr` has a test that injects the value `2` into the imputations of a
  logical variable and expects an error. Since mice 3.19.12, `complete()`
  keeps logical variables logical (#764), so no error is raised.

The 5 packages we failed to check (`brms`, `dynr`, `idem`, `pguIMP`,
`rmsb`) could not be installed locally because of Stan, rJava and
configure problems, unrelated to mice.

See <https://github.com/amices/mice/tree/master/revdep> for details.
